limitations: Each implicate's imputed amounts stay fixed across replicates, so the replicates leave out the sampling variability of the CE rent model and of the CPS ASEC samples behind the participation models
Implicates draw model parameters from covariances that ignore the CPS ASEC and CE designs' strata and clusters

In 2015Q2 and 2017Q1, most consumer units interviewed in both that quarter and the one before changed their pattern of positive and zero replicate weights, so under one replicate number a unit's interviews on either side can fall in different half samples; the 2019-2021 windows span one or both quarters, and their replicates can miss part of the correlation between a unit's interviews
The FCSUti-index run deflates every component by BLS's published index, so its price factors do not vary across replicates

Garner (2010, BLS Working Paper 436) computed the standard errors of BLS's 2006-2008 experimental thresholds by balanced repeated replication with the CE's 44 replicate weights; BLS's methods page and threshold workbooks do not say how its current replicates treat the percentile band or the imputed benefits

method.combining: Rubin's rules: T = U + (1 + 1/M) B, with U the mean of the implicates' replicate variances and B the variance of their full-sample estimates (divisor M - 1)
method.df: Barnard and Rubin (1999): 1 / (1 / nu_m + 1 / nu_obs), with nu_m = (M - 1) / lambda^2, nu_obs = nu_com (nu_com + 1) (1 - lambda) / (nu_com + 3), lambda = (1 + 1/M) B / T and nu_com = 43; figures without the stage use 43
held_fixed: each implicate's imputed in-kind amounts, as the full-sample imputation drew them

the CPS ASEC participation and amount models and the CE rent model, fit once with full-sample weights; each implicate draws their parameters from the inverse of the weighted information matrix, with weights scaled to mean one
the CPI series and BLS's FCSUti index
method.interval: estimate +/- t_975 * standard_error, t on df
replicated: the sample: records whose replicate weight is zero drop out
the package deflator's CPI component weights, which come from CE spending
the 47th-53rd percentile band and the band means

sources.barnard_rubin: Barnard, J. and Rubin, D. B. (1999). Small-sample degrees of freedom with multiple imputation. Biometrika 86(4): 948-955.
sources.rubin: Rubin, D. B. (1987). Multiple Imputation for Nonresponse in Surveys. Wiley.
